dashboards.title: reliant: overview
dashboards.description: Request rate, error rate and latency per service, top errors and recent error logs. Generated by forge from the project's services; narrow with the service.name and deployment.environment.name filters.

panels.title: Requests per service
panels.description: Count per time bucket.

panels.title: Error rate per service
panels.description: Server faults (span status Error) over all requests. Client errors such as NotFound are not counted.

panels.title: Rate, errors and latency by service

dashboards.title: reliant: account service
dashboards.description: RED per rpc of reliant.v1.AccountService (server spans named reliant.v1.AccountService/<Method>), Go runtime and logs. The Go runtime panels describe the PROCESS that serves this service: narrow with the service.name filter.

dashboards.title: reliant: workloads
dashboards.description: Per-workload customer metadata from the node agent: CPU and memory against requests and limits, restarts and the last exit reason, the image versions that ran, and Kubernetes events. Present in deployed environments only (a local forge env up has no node agent).

panels.title: CPU usage
panels.description: Average CPU cores used per container, one line per workload.

panels.title: Memory working set
panels.description: Average working-set bytes per container, one line per workload.

panels.title: CPU against its request
panels.description: The busiest container of each workload as a fraction of the CPU it requested (1 = at the request).

panels.title: CPU against its limit
panels.description: The busiest container of each workload as a fraction of its CPU limit. Near 1 the container is being throttled.

panels.title: Memory against its request
panels.description: The fullest container of each workload as a fraction of the memory it requested.

panels.title: Memory against its limit
panels.description: The fullest container of each workload as a fraction of its memory limit. Near 1 the container is about to be OOM-killed.

panels.title: Container restarts
panels.description: The highest restart count among each workload's containers; a step is a restart.

panels.title: Restarts by last exit reason
panels.description: The same restart count split by why the container last terminated (OOMKilled, Error, Completed, ...).

panels.title: CPU by image version
panels.description: CPU used per container, split by the image tag it ran (container.image.tag), so a rollout shows as one line replacing another.

panels.title: Memory by image version
panels.description: Working-set bytes per container, split by image tag: a version that leaks memory climbs above its predecessor.

panels.title: Kubernetes events by reason
panels.description: Count of Kubernetes events per reason (BackOff, Failed, Evicted, Killing, ...) over time.

panels.title: Warning events by workload
panels.description: Warning-type Kubernetes events per workload: crash loops, failed image pulls, evictions, failed scheduling.

panels.title: Container terminations
panels.description: Events that carry a container's last terminated reason.

panels.title: Kubernetes events
panels.description: Every Kubernetes event of the selected workloads, newest first.

dashboards.title: reliant: releases
dashboards.description: Request rate, error rate and latency split by service.version, so a deploy shows as one version replacing another. Deploy markers come from the release ledger. Narrow with the service.name and deployment.environment.name filters.

panels.title: Error rate by version
panels.description: Server faults (span status Error) over all requests, per version.

panels.title: Version comparison
panels.description: Requests, errors and latency per service.version over the selected range. Pick a range that spans a deploy to read old against new.
